check-in.prompt: You are still here. How is it going?

options.label: Pretty well
options.reply: Good. Keep a little energy for yourself.

options.label: I am tired
options.reply: Then rest. The world can wait for five minutes.

options.label: Not great
options.reply: …Stay here for a moment. You do not have to solve it all now.

work.prompt: Still working? Of course you are.

options.label: Almost done
options.reply: Finish the small part, then stop.

options.label: There is too much
options.reply: Choose one thing. The rest can be tomorrow's problem.

options.label: I am procrastinating
options.reply: Reasonable. Just do one tiny step before we continue.

food.prompt: Have you eaten? I cannot keep reminding you forever.

options.label: Not yet
options.reply: Go eat something. I will guard the cursor.

options.label: Later
options.reply: Later has a habit of becoming never.

fish.prompt: You opened a whole window just to talk to a fish.

options.label: I needed a break
options.reply: Then take one. We can stare at nothing together.
